lines: This town, where numerous criminal organizations vied for supremacy (with Nomad and Ryuumon first on the list), was famous for rain falling in spite of being belowground.
The rain from the surface would travel through the earth over a long period, and fall again from the subterranean ceiling.
In Yomihara, the city where that “rain from the past” fell, there was a detective agency.
「Mmm, good work. What's on the menu today?」
「Beef stew... Cow meat. Thank you... Mr. Cow.」
「Once again, Nasara-chan's being a good girl today, eh? Gotta be real grateful to the cow who died for our sakes, right?」
「Idiot. Don't say stuff like that right before we eat. You're gonna ruin the meal.」
「Being thankful for your food's important. Once again, this little rugrat's not being a good girl today, huh?」
「Wh-Who's a rugrat?! I've told you time and time again, this is a temporary form!!」
「Even if it's temporary, appearances are important for people. Why can't little kids understand I just want them to act like little kids?」
「Hmph, like I would know! Honestly! This is why I hate Taimanin!」
「Okay, okay. If you're going to quarrel, do it over there, all right? Meals should be merry and fun. That's the rule in this house.」
「Yeah, this tastes pretty good. But, huh? Mm? Mmm?」
「What part of this is beef stew? There's no meat in it at all, is there?!」
「Ah, I was right? I was wondering what was up, 'cuz for some reason, there wasn't any no matter where I looked.」
「You don't call beef stew with no meat in it beef stew!」
「I call it that when we have no money.」
「Did you think the opposite? It's supposed to be just me here, living as I please, but then I get a lot of freeloaders all at once, and my expenses are piling up.」
「On top of that, we have a Great Witch who's secretly buying mysterious herbs.」
「We have a Taimanin who borrows money without asking, to give a New Year's gift to her relative's child.」
「So because of things like that, this is what our beef stews are going to be like for a while, okay? Got that? Understood? Come on, answer me.」
「Y-Yes. I'll make sure to pay back the money next time.」
「Besides, look at this. Nasara is eating it up like it's that delicious, whether it has meat or not.」
「(Munch-munch, munch-munch.) Asagi's cooking... Yummy... Love it. (Munch-munch, munch-munch.)♪」
「She just doesn't know any better. What about being grateful to the cow? There isn't one, is there? Honestly.」
「Ah, but she's got sauce stuck all around her mouth. Nasara-chan is seriously cute now, isn't she? Here, here, Onee-san will wipe it off for you!」
「Mind your manners, Nasara. Well, still, we'll have to do something about money, won't we? Haah.」
「Eh? Are we in enough of a pinch for you to make a gloomy face and sigh like that?」
「I can't help but feel responsible, you know. As your guardian.」
「Mmm, that won't do. If you like, why don't I share one or two of the magic potions I've made? They'd go for a high price!」
「I haven't tested, but probably. It's a traditional recipe.」
「My magic power's a bit diminished right now, so it might have unforeseen effects, but, well, I guess it'll be fine as long as I add a warning label.」
「That's not fine. I don't want to get a strange reputation. I'm going to go looking for work, like a normal person.」
「In that case, I'll go too. Gotta help our landlady out of her predicament, right? You coming too, Nasara-chan?」
「Then, I'll go with you too. Even if my form is different, my wisdom'll be useful to you, 'cuz that hasn't changed one bit! Ha ha ha!」
（I kind of think the work would get done faster with me on my own, but...... Oh well.）
And so, the whole detective team finished eating their special beef stew, and shuffled off to a bar which served as a job placement office for private eyes, mercenaries and the like.
That bar, which was crowded from midday on, was Kousaka Shizuru's establishment.
Only a very limited number of people knew that she was actually a Taimanin from Gosha.
Shizuru was, for whatever reason, dressed as Santa.
「A Santa outfit. Cute, don't you think?」
「It's silly to worry about seasons in Yomihara. Right, everyone?」
「I wanna ask Santa for stuff every day!」
The regulars were getting fired up, egged on by her Santa outfit.
Ignoring that, Clone Asagi continued the conversation.
「I do, but I don't suppose you'll like it.」
「I'm broke right now. I'll take anything.」
「That's why you brought the whole gang along?」
「You can rely on me for anything! My magnanimous self will take care of it in an instant!」
「With four people, we can do anything!」
「Okay. If you say so, there's a client at the table at the back.」
Shizuru giggled, and motioned her head in that direction.
Clone Asagi was about to head over to them, when she stopped dead in her tracks.
「I did tell you you probably wouldn't like it.」
Sure enough, sitting at the table in the back was Demonologist Kiryuu Mikoto.
The self-proclaimed foremost Demonologist in Hell.
As far as Clone Asagi knew, she reckoned that was probably true.
She was also, without a doubt, the foremost mad scientist in Hell, constantly conducting unscrupulous experiments.
Her right arm was the transplanted arm of a demon god, which (according to her) she had been bequeathed by a mage.
She boasted that it was from a mythic-level Otherworld being, and that if she were to swing a sword with that arm, it would become enveloped in potent miasma and shake the very earth.
（We certainly got off to a bad start......）
Clone Asagi was a cyborg. Unlike someone flesh-and-blood, her body required periodic maintenance.
However, after deserting the UFS's Secret Service Agency G, she hadn't been able to undergo maintenance for a long time.
Thus, she had gradually been rendered powerless and finally gotten captured by an enemy, and the one who had saved her was this Kiryuu Mikoto.
Of course, Clone Asagi had been grateful at the time, but by now, she realized that it had been because Mikoto harboured a strange interest in her body.
Ever since that, she had been receiving maintenance from her in exchange for money, job requests, etc.
However, most of Mikoto's assignments were for dubious things, so she tried not to communicate with her as much as possible, apart from when it was unavoidable, like for maintenance and whatnot.
And now was one of those “unavoidable” times.
「Don't make such a sour face. Come, sit, sit. Ufufu.」
Mikoto wore the smiling face that she always did when she was going to make a worthless request.
It was not for assassin work.
It was to have someone treat her eyes, which had been getting worse and worse.
Needless to say, an ordinary physician wasn't even worth considering.
Her eyes, which mesmerized whoever looked at them, were a kind of so-called Evil Eye.
If it were Gosha Village, where the Fuuma clan (who were known as Evil Eye users) lived, there might be a specialist.
However, having being exiled from the village with her now-deceased parents, there was no way she could return there.
Plus, she had heard that the current Fuuma head was a “Diot”, who, far from an Evil Eye, hadn't even awoken to his Ninja Art yet.
She couldn't pin her hopes on a person like that.
Thus, she had decided to go to Yomihara, based on information that Hell's foremost Demonologist was there.
Yuri looked around the vast area, which even resembled a temple, where massive pillars lined up in rows.
She was currently in the Metropolitan Area New Outer Discharge Channel, which was below Tokyo.
It was a facility constructed 100 metres underground, even further below the Metropolitan Area Outer Discharge Channel, which was at a depth of 50 metres.
It had been a structure created as a precaution against disasters in the area, but, as usual, the plans had come to a halt midway through.
That spot, which had been left unfinished, had become just about the only passage to the underground city of Yomihara.
Yomihara was in an even deeper location. This place was barely the halfway point.
（It's late now. I'll make camp here tonight.）
Yomihara was famous as a criminal city, but she had heard that great numbers of armed refugees had taken up residence in this discharge channel too.
Of course, she wanted to avoid unnecessary trouble.

Yuri began to search for a place where it looked like she would be able to rest, and where she could hide herself as much as possible, but the immensely vast space, and the rows of pillars that went on forever, were robbing her of
Which was why she didn't notice signs of enemies approaching until they were right up close.
And by the time she realized, she was surrounded by a mob of armed refugees.
The men's vulgar gazes stared intently at Yuri.
It was plain as day what they wanted.
「If you don't attack me, I won't attack you.」
However, that cool voice seemed to provoke the men even further.
The armed refugees chortled as they pointed their guns at Yuri.
「Kekekeh, I can tell even through that weird mask. You're a beauty for sure.」
「Try spreadin' your legs and sayin' please. We'll go a little easier on ya!」
While sighing, Yuri drew her kodachi.
（Let's get this done without using my Bewitching Eye, if possible.）
